title: Other New Orleans men in Chicago: Big Eye Louis, Baquet, Dreamland bands
summary: Later bands that followed the Creole Band to Chicago, and Garland's own bands at Dreamland with Lorenzo Tio on clarinet.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Then the next band went, Big Eye Lewy. He come along. Big Eye Lewy was with Freddie and, uh, and-and-and-and George Backe was with, uh, And, uh, George Fields was with Manuel. Then when I was at the Dreamland, I went to Wake Down and Peekin for Dan Jackson, and I used to have Manuel, Teo, Frankie Enya, see, and, uh, Eddie Atkins on some bones.
